items.html: But what has now changed from the first time, from the time the dots of the eyes came out, is this: then the dot of Keter stood alone, by itself, in its place, and after it the dot of Hochma alone, by itself, and so it was with all ten Sefirot. But now a great correction was added, which is that the dot of Keter was drawn and expanded from its place down to near the end of the legs of AK. And this expansion is the whole measure called by the name the world of Atzilut. And this dot is called Nukva of Atik Yomin. And likewise Atik Yomin Dechura, made from the Teamim of MA as above, also expands to the aforementioned measure. And so did all the rest — AA and its Nukva, and Aba ve Ima, and ZON — and each clothed the other down to the aspect of ZON, so that all the legs of the Partzufim of Atzilut — whether of Atik, of AA, of Aba ve Ima, or of ZON — are all equal at their end, and they end together a little above the end of the legs of AK, and there is the end of the whole of Atzilut. And through this they became a soul to one another, each clothing the other. And also through this the created beings will be able to receive the upper lights, which are now covered and clothed one inside the other. And also because through this their vessels grew larger, having expanded downward, and thereby they have the power to receive their lights, being large vessels.
